programs.title: Deewane Huye Paagal
programs.desc: After witnessing a murder committed by a gangster, a young girl named Tanya flees to Dubai. Her friend Karan, who loves her, goes after her only to realise that she is pursued by a few more suitors, including the gangster himself.

programs.desc: Four young loafers wish to simplify their life by wooing a loaded heiress. Unfortunately, there's only one rich girl in the neighbourhood. The boys scamper to woo her first, not knowing that their efforts would lead them right into a murder mystery.
